description: This file defines a RouteSubscriber class for Drupal's block_content module, handling route alterations and BC (backward compatibility) redirects for block content routes.

classes.name: Drupal lock_contentRoutingouteSubscriber
classes.description: Defines a route subscriber for handling BC route redirects in block content module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing entity type manager and module handler services.

methods.name: alterRoutes
methods.description: Alters routes to add BC redirect routes based on existing routes.

methods.name: setUpBaseRoute
methods.description: Sets up base route parameters for BC redirects.

methods.name: addRedirectRoute
methods.description: Adds a BC redirect route for a given route name.

methods.name: childRoutes
methods.description: Generates a list of route names that require BC redirects based on entity type.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Specifies the events this subscriber listens to, particularly route alteration events.
